description:
Code, test and implement ASP .Net pages. The pages and functionality have been designed. There may be design changes and Worker should be able to work with employees and Systems Analyst to update design specifications and documentation. The system developed will need to pass security standards for an external facing web application, and comply with State accessibility standards for web applications. 
 

 
 Minimum Requirements:  

· ASP.net Framework 4 or later, developing secure web applications, developing accessible applications.

· Developing web applications using ASP.NET MVC

· Developing web applications using Microsoft SQL Server 2012 or later.

· Developing web applications with emphases on user interface and user experience design.

· Web services programming experience.

· Experience working with Team Foundation Server 2015


 Preferences:
 
· Experience developing ASP.NET MVC 4.0 web applications.

· Experience working in a State/Federal government environment.

· Experience with TDLR programs a plus. 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
